title: DCD: Decomposition-based Causal Discovery from Autocorrelated and Non-Stationary Temporal Data
abstract: arXiv:2602.01433v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multivariate time series in domains such as finance, climate science, and healthcare often exhibit long-term trends, seasonal patterns, and short-term fluctuations, complicating causal inference under non-stationarity and autocorrelation. Existing causal discovery methods typically operate on raw observations, making them vulnerable to spurious edges and misattributed temporal dependencies. We introduce a decomposition-based causal discovery framework that separates each time series into trend, seasonal, and residual components and performs component-specific causal analysis. Trend components are assessed using stationarity tests, seasonal components using kernel-based dependence measures, and residual components using constraint-based causal discovery. translated_title: DCD：基于分解的自相关与非平稳时间序列数据因果发现方法
translated_abstract: 金融、气候科学和医疗保健等领域的多变量时间序列通常表现出长期趋势、季节性模式和短期波动，这使得在非平稳性和自相关性条件下的因果推断变得复杂。现有的因果发现方法通常直接在原始观测数据上运行，容易产生虚假边和错误归因的时间依赖关系。我们提出了一种基于分解的因果发现框架，将每个时间序列分解为趋势、季节和残差三个分量，并对各分量进行针对性的因果分析。趋势分量使用平稳性检验进行评估，季节分量使用基于核函数的依赖性度量方法，残差分量则使用基于约束的因果发现方法。由此得到的分量级图被整合为一个统一的多尺度因果结构。这种方法能够分离长程和短程因果效应，减少虚假边……
tldr: 提出了一种基于分解的因果发现框架DCD，通过将时间序列分解为趋势、季节和残差分量并分别进行针对性因果分析，有效减少了非平稳和自相关数据中的虚假因果关系，并构建出统一的多尺度因果结构。
en_tdlr: Proposes DCD, a decomposition-based causal discovery framework that separates time series into trend, seasonal, and residual components for component-specific causal analysis, reducing spurious edges and enabling unified multi-scale causal structures in autocorrelated and non-stationary temporal data.
